trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Per release history, v2.3.1 had never been healthy in production; the most recent healthy release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.

3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy with a 0.2% error rate across all regions.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.
